english.title: Import prohibited weapons / ammunition with intent to evade a prohibition / restriction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[imported]_
(B)_[were concerned in the importing of]_

(C)_[a prohibited weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WEAPON..),]_
(D)_[prohibited weapons]_
(E)_[prohibited ammunition]_

contrary to a

(F)_[prohibition]_
(G)_[restriction, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTION..),]_

in force by virtue of **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..) with respect to

(H)_[that weapon]_
(I)_[those weapons]_
(J)_[that ammunition]_

and with intent to evade the

(K)_[prohibition]_
(L)_[restriction]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(3), (4) and (5A)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
import / concerned in the import
of prohibited weapons / ammunition
contrary to a prohibition / restriction
in force by virtue of an enactment
with respect to the weapons / ammunition
and with intent
to evade the prohibition

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(ii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions

This offence document and associated codes should only be used for offences committed on or after 14 July 2014. For offences committed before this date use document H10654

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Life imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex

libra.complexpenaltydetails: The financial penalty on summary conviction is the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater
